messages:
alex_smith: kicking off thread to prep capacity plan for ACME ERP POC. they asked for commit guidance and an enterprise runway proposal. low friction ask: what do we need for a 30-day POC at ~150 rps peak?
maria_ng: thanks. can we confirm workload: mostly chat completions with 1.5k token responses avg, bursty around payroll runs (daily windows).
ingrid_k: @maria_ng if it's 150 rps * 1.5k tokens, that's ~225k tokens/sec sustained during bursts — that's heavy. need to confirm concurrency vs long-tail.
tom_brooks: rough mapping: on our c5/dedicated plan each A100-equivalent GPU can handle ~120 rps at 1.5k tokens with our optimized runtime (latency SLO 300ms p95). so baseline 2 GPUs for sustained 150 rps, 3 for headroom + prewarm.
maria_ng: pricing question for ACME: are we proposing reserved 3-GPU pool or reserved 2 + burst credits? customer prefers lower commit and pay-for-burst.
lia_security: flag: ACME will need SOC2 + customer-managed KMS. Private deployment option might be required for certain data flows; that affects capacity placement (on-prem vs hosted).
alex_smith: goal: present 2 options in the deck — (A) conservative commit: 3 reserved GPUs + autoscale policy for bursts (recommended), (B) minimal commit: 2 reserved GPUs + on-demand burst with pre-approved burst credits. include cost delta and risk notes.
maria_ng: note on autoscale policy: we should have cooldowns and prewarm triggers around payroll windows. sample policy below for the sales doc: 
```
{
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "target_rps_per_replica": 100,
  "max_replicas": 6,
  "scale_up_window_sec": 30,
  "scale_down_window_sec": 300,
  "prewarm_rules": [{"cron": "0 02 * * *", "keep_replicas": 4}]
}
```
maria_ng: this is just pseudo-config, show to ACME as an ops-friendly pattern.
ingrid_k: operational notes: enable prefix KV caching for common prompts (saves ~30% token work). also enable continuous batching with max_batch_size tuned to maintain p95 requirement.
tom_brooks: capacity runway math for the deck:
- Option A (3 reserved): handles sustained 150 rps + 2x burst headroom, prewarm minutes = 3
- Option B (2 reserved + burst): base handles ~120 rps sustained, bursts rely on cold on-demand which adds ~1-2s cold-start; add fallback model tier for graceful degradation
lia_security: add security Q note: if customer requires VPC peering + HSM KMS, Private deployment adds ~2-4 weeks onboarding to provisioning timeline. include that in SLA/Ramp slide.
alex_smith: can someone draft the cost delta: monthly commit cost vs estimated on-demand for a 30-day POC (assume 200k token/hr average)? try to include token and infra cost.
maria_ng: I'll run the calc and post numbers later today. quick sanity: reserved 3x A100 equiv = ~Xk/mo; on-demand spikes could double that if unbounded.
jess_bot: [deploy-bot] template: poc-runbook, link: https://redwood.internal/poc-runbook (use this for steps: capacity, security checklist, SLOs).
ingrid_k: final ops checklist for sales handoff:
- confirm profile: tokens per response, avg response length
- spike windows + cron schedule for prewarm
- acceptable cold-start latency and fallback model
- required compliance (SOC2/KMS)
- retention & audit log window
- run a smoke test with 1-hour soak at 2x expected load
alex_smith: perfect. I'll assemble a one-pager with two options and hand to ACME tomorrow AM. @maria_ng @ingrid_k please add the numbers and any caveats. :thumbsup:
